title: Last of the Mohicans James Fenimore Cooper Full Leather Easton Press Collector’s
descriptionText: This rare and collectible edition of "Last of the Mohicans" by James Fenimore Cooper is a must-have for any history enthusiast. The full leather binding, crafted by Easton Press, is sure to impress and make a great addition to any collection. Written in English, the book tells a captivating story of the last Mohican tribe in America. The author, James Fenimore Cooper, is well-known for his historical writings and this book is no exception. The topic of the book is historical and it falls under the category of Antiquarian & Collectible books. Get your hands on this gem today!
